اعلوليتم (form XII)
# اِعْلَوْلَيْتُمْ (iʕlawlaytum) /iʕ.law.laj.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
# اُعْلُولِيتُمْ (uʕlūlītum) /uʕ.luː.liː.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
